name: @qu/relay
description: A Node.js Qu peer: persists to disk (FsAdapter, both /store and /blob), syncs with other peers over WebSocket (@qu/sync), delivers Web Push notifications for thread messages, loads/serves Engines, Services and Apps via @qu/loader (local auto-discovery + dependency-ordered load at boot, optional integrity-checked remote apps, an apps.json catalog, and static app serving so other relays can load what this one hosts), and serves apps/shell (the browser entry point) at /. Built on @qu/foundation's RuntimeContainer from day one (docs/v3-technical-concept.md §2.1) instead of one growing composition-root class - PresenceTracker, RelaySettings, VapidKeyStore, PushDeliveryService, AdminHttp and HttpRouter are each independently testable modules.
